title: Dispersion for the Schr{ö}dinger equation on the line with short-range array of delta potentials
summary: We study dispersive properties of the one-dimensional Schr{ö}dinger equation with a short-range array of delta interactions. More precisely, we consider the self-adjoint operator obtained by perturbing the free Laplacian on the line with a real-valued sequence of Dirac delta potentials and belonging to weighted ${\ell}$^1(Z) spaces. Under suitable decay assumptions on the coupling constants and in the absence of a zero-energy resonance, we establish the L^1 (R) $\rightarrow$ L^$\infty$ (R) dispersive estimate with decay rate |t|^{-1/2} for the associated Schr{ö}dinger group.
